newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil up, fuel oil bullish.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil up, fuel oil bullish.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Thursday morning, with bullishness noticeably entering the fuel oil market, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $98 fob ARA and subsequent offers were at $99, a gain of about $3 a tonne. In a reversal of the pattern of the last week, bids were numerous and offers scarce.
Heating oil barges were $1/$2 a tonne higher as IPE gas oil futures rose. Offers for early February deliveries remained at around Feb IPE +$3 fob ARA.
